 County Offices, Public Health Centers To Close For Veterans Day: Lemon Grove
 Lemon Grove residents should expect temporary changes to county government services Wednesday, Nov. 11.
 Doc Louallen , Patch Staff 
 Posted Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 12:04 pm PT LEMON GROVE, CA — Lemon Grove residents planning to visit county government offices or public health facilities should prepare for closures Wednesday, Nov. 11, as San Diego County observes Veterans Day.
 The county announced that government offices, family resource centers, county-operated libraries, public health centers and animal shelters will close for the holiday.
 The closures will affect in-person county services, including assistance provided through family resource centers and public health offices.
 Find out what's happening in Lemon Grove for free with the latest updates from Patch. 
 Subscribe By subscribing, you agree to Patch's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use . Residents who need help with county-administered programs or have appointments scheduled around the holiday are encouraged to check with the appropriate office before visiting.
 County parks and campgrounds will remain open during regular operating hours, although some recreation and community center offices will be closed.
 Find out what's happening in Lemon Grove for free with the latest updates from Patch. 
 Subscribe By subscribing, you agree to Patch's Privacy Policy and Terms of Use . Essential services, including law enforcement and emergency animal control response, will continue throughout Veterans Day.
 Normal county government operations are expected to resume Thursday, Nov. 12.
 The federal holiday is observed annually Nov. 11 to honor military veterans who have served in the U.S. armed forces.
 For more information about affected facilities and services, visit San Diego County's official website .
